kitDescription: Queen is a Fire-element shotgun Attacker whose kit is built for fighting Wind bosses, since Fire beats Wind. She permanently buffs her own elemental-advantage damage, defense, and attack damage from the start of battle, and gains a large 15-second ATK buff at battle start and again every time Full Burst ends. Her burst deals a heavy distributed-damage hit to all enemies; if a Wind enemy is present, the burst also grants her a 10-second ATK buff called 1 More, which in turn triggers an additional distributed-damage strike and would pass an ATK buff to Persona-state Burst III allies. When she enters Burst Stage 3 she gains a short Distributed Damage buff, and casting her burst wraps her in Fist of Justice, further raising her elemental-advantage damage and defense until Full Burst ends. Against non-Wind bosses, the 1 More chain and elemental-advantage lines simply never activate.

faithfulnessScore: 1.0 (11/11 kit lines FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP; the two gaps — Follow Up rider, Baton Pass — are deliberate, verbatim-documented, and recipe-flagged)
verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs survive this round: the round-1 SILENT_DROP of the 1 More distributed rider is fixed and the driver's burstCast + bossElementGate-Wind decomposition now matches S6's independent blind derivation exactly, which is the strongest convergence signal available in a same-model gauntlet. S5's 30/30 green run against the shipped override is corroborated at every load-bearing point by counterfactual patches (each throws if the fixture goes stale) and by neutral-boss negative assertions that pin both Wind gates — the two largest over-credit traps in the kit (ungated 548.99% rider, ungated 30.27% ATK buff) are provably closed. The two divergences that remain are resolved in the driver's favor or are non-load-bearing: Baton Pass is a DOCUMENTED_GAP because S6's modeled version drops the Persona-state and B3-only filters and would wrongly buff helm, and the Distributed Damage 90.01% trigger (burstCast vs S6's stageEnter-3) is co-frame for this B3 unit, with the same-cast ordering question already ⚑-flagged by the driver. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: S6 adds explicit "crit": true to both flatDamage effects while the driver omits it — faithful only if the engine's flatDamage path crits at caster rate by default (the SSOT documents crit-OFF as specific to storedHit, implying so); a one-line engine confirmation closes this. Secondary micro-note: Fist of Justice's 'deactivates when Full Burst ends' is encoded as a fixed 10s, equivalent at scope lock but not the prose's semantics. Verdict GO; ship the override and tests as-is.
